name: Demon Domain
description:
Demon Domain

In this bank the player chooses his reward - Devils or Efreet Sultans.

Value: 4000
Rarity: 40

Size 1: guarded by 5x7 Cerberi, gives 1 Devil / 3 Efreet Sultans (40%)
Size 2: guarded by 5x14 Cerberi, gives 2 Devils / 6 Efreet Sultans (40%)
Size 3: guarded by 5x21 Cerberi, gives 3 Devils / 9 Efreet Sultans (20%)

If HotA mod is enabled, Demon Domain substitutes Red Tower.
author: wnukos, Andruids (graphics)
